full_page.content:
1931, September
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1.
Page 43 Cont.
Sep 19 Eliz. Reuschling 44 non catholic enrolled by Cath. neighbor in June - full of cancer - liver, stomach, throat, breast and 27 on her back. Suffered terribly wanted to be a Catholic but had lost her sight, and at times mind also. Hour and half before death received sight - seeing husband and friends - and something else that extremely de- lighted her. Clapping her hands and exclaiming "O how beautiful!", died very happily - bidding husband & all "Good Bye".
Oct. 12 Catherine Arata from Cincinnati in anxiety arives here by interurban trolley at 9 a.m. enrolls Jewish Banker Samuel Lehman who cheated her of her "will and legacy $10,000. and now is in dying condition. We hope he will wake up and get a conscience before going before God.
Oct 13 Mrs. Mary E. Reynolds 59 of Clinton Ont. Ca. 17 years with Epli. Fits, enrolled July (abot) 25th has not had a shadow of an atack since. Deo Gr.
Miss Viatrice Aylor, non Cath. Heart trouble. Enrolls perpetually
Oct. 20 To-day (P.M. ) went to Mt Vernon Mem. Park, had supper with colored folks in Dexter - Too bad some one cannot go to them regularly for service .... a good field.
Page 44 Oct. 28 Penticitis - Pertinitis. 9:45 About ten minutes ago Miss A. Horny who had enrolled John Daley her 14 yr-old nephew two days ago as an annual member, requested over phone that I enroll him now as perpe- tual member. Before requesting the perpetual membership complained that the boy had very little improved. Now tells me he has gone into good sleep. pertinitis
Out of danger
Oct. 30 Oct 29 Mrs. Mary (Leo) Gabourin reports (after enrolling him) that her hus- band Leo was trapped three years ago last august - dropped into cel- lar and three days was kept unknown to his family (Wife & 2 children) for three days. He has had to pay $10 per week all this time besides twice $50. .... Kept in suspence continually and family in anxiety. We are enrolling
Nov 14 Ed. Martz enrolls Poor Souls whenever trouble threatens. Night be- fore last he enrolled them that they might help him find mistake of $10,000.00. Yesterday first thing in the morning the mistake was discovered without the least delay. Bank with which the deal made the mistake. Ed. Exclaimed: "There's the Mass-Association!" -- Like a miracle. Ordinarily it would probably taken a week.
